name: Production manifold / headers with production and test headers to commingle fluids
description: Wellhead gathering manifold and headers that commingle flows from multiple wells, route them to production and test headers, distribute injection fluids/chemicals and provide isolation and pigging interfaces. On a typical platform the process train is listed as wellhead, production manifold, production separator, glycol dehydration, gas compressors, water injection pumps, oil/gas export metering and main oil line pumps (Wikipedia Oil platform, read).
